analysis.purpose: Initializes three child objects, stores them in an existing owner, sets float components, flags and IDs, and attaches each child. UI/HUD and RGBA interpretations remain hypotheses.
analysis.observed_abi: a0 is the owner pointer, preserved in s1; s0 tracks children. Stack frame is 0x48 bytes. No explicit return value is materialized; the caller ignores the result, so the original return type is unproved. Owner offsets 0x38/0x3C/0x40 hold child pointers; owner+0x10 is passed to attachment. Child offsets 0x04 and 0x14 are updated during attachment, 0xC4 receives flag bits, 0xD0 receives IDs, and 0x124/0x128/0x12C/0x130 hold floats.
